basis.summary: Implement watcher-driven cycle release and redispatch-quality controls before broader runtime features.
basis.rationale: This directly reduces non-actionable cycles and improves output per token budget.
basis.expected_impact: Lower idle loops and better per-cycle productivity under constrained hardware/rate limits.

basis.summary: Expand canary task coverage for runtime coordination path regressions.
basis.rationale: Gate failures earlier by linking KPI drift to concrete lane-level recommendations.
basis.expected_impact: Faster issue isolation and lower failure amplification across planner/runtime handoffs.
